newsitem.title: USA: Nobility Homes sees higher Q4 sales, EPS.
newsitem.headline: Nobility Homes sees higher Q4 sales, EPS.

text.p: Nobility Homes Inc said on Wednesday it expected increased sales and earnings in its fiscal fourth quarter because of the improving Florida real estate market.
"Our strong sales and earnings results continue to reflect an improving market in Florida for our homes," Nobility Homes President Terry Trexler said in a statement.

"With record sales backlogs, the addition of new retail sales locations and continued favorable mortgage rates, the company also expects to report an increase in sales and earnings for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996," he said.

Nobility Homes said its third quarter sales increased 30 percent from a year earlier, to $9.99 million. Net income rose to $633,648, or $0.21 per share, from $501,567. or $0.17 per share. The year-ago figures exclude $1 million in non-recurring income.
